dedupe_keys.name: open synthetic data on travel and charging demand of battery electric cars in vastra gotaland sweden

description: This data product holds the inputs, assumptions and outputs of an agent-based simulation of the travel and charging demand of battery electric cars under three charging behaviour archetypes. It covers 284,000 car agents living in the Västra Götaland region around Gothenburg, drawn from a synthetic population of Sweden with dwelling types and weekday activity plans; their MATSim travel trajectories are combined with overnight charger access, a car fleet composition based on the current Swedish private fleet, and a Swedish road network with slope, and ten scenarios of charging behaviour and fast-charging power are simulated. Files include activity plans, home charger access, car fleet, the road network shapefile, scenario definitions and the time history of trajectories and charging (a 14.5 GB output archive). It was produced at Chalmers University of Technology and described in Transportation Research Part D (2023). Coverage is regional, with trips across Sweden, for an average weekday. The data are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (version 1.0 of 8 February 2023). Caveats: the population is synthetic, and results depend on the archetype assumptions. The data support capacity planning of charging infrastructure, agent-based studies of electric vehicle use and grid impact analysis, and relate to MATSim and to the synthetic Sweden population model the authors derived them from.
name: Open synthetic data on travel and charging demand of battery electric cars in Västra Götaland, Sweden
provider: Chalmers University of Technology, Department of Space, Earth and Environment (Yuan Liao, Caglar Tozluoglu, Frances Sprei, Sonia Yeh)

sources.note: version 1.0 of 2023-02-08; CC BY 4.0; Chalmers creators; background and methodology (1.7 million VG inhabitants, 284,000 car agents, MATSim, ten scenarios); seven data files and sizes (7_output.zip 14,496 MB); isCitedBy TRD article; isDerivedFrom github.com/TheYuanLiao/synthetic-sweden

spatial_resolution: individual agents and activity locations (DeSO zones); road links with slope
